Title: NETMESSAGE:Time to go spearfishing! Hunt all fishes to proceed.
Translation: 是时候去叉鱼了！猎杀所有鱼才能继续。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Choose M16 Grunt or Shotgun Grunt.
Translation: 选择M16步枪兵或霰弹枪兵。

Title: NETMESSAGE:M16 was chosen.
Translation: M16被选中了。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Shotgun was chosen.
Translation: 霰弹枪被选中了。

Title: NETMESSAGE:New spawn point reached!
Translation: 新的重生点已到达！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Sorry, but the Triforce is in another Castle!
Translation: 抱歉，但三角力量在另一座城堡！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Voice: What made you think you were allowed to enter here, HUH!?
Translation: 声音：是什么让你觉得你可以进入这里，嗯！？

Title: NETMESSAGE:We're done with these lads. Let's get out of here.
Translation: 这些家伙搞定了，我们离开这里吧。

Title: NETMESSAGE:A shortcut is now available.\n(At the garden door.)
Translation: 现在有一条捷径可用。\n（在花园门口。）

Title: NETMESSAGE:New spawn points unlocked.
Translation: 新的重生点已解锁。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Here! We can get out through the maintenance access!
Translation: 这里！我们可以通过维修通道出去！

Title: NETMESSAGE:You have 45 seconds to find and disable every alarm in this room.
Translation: 你有45秒的时间找到并关闭这个房间里的所有警报器。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Starting area in 5 seconds...
Translation: 5秒后开始区域...

Title: NETMESSAGE:Go! Disable the alarms before the timer runs out!
Translation: 快！在时间耗尽前关闭警报器！

Title: NETMESSAGE:You did it! The day is saved!
Translation: 你做到了！今天得救了！

Title: NETMESSAGE:You've failed!
Translation: 你失败了！

Title: NETMESSAGE:The exit is now open
Translation: 出口现在打开了。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Part 2 still under construction.\nThanks for playing!!!
Translation: 第二部分仍在建设中。\n感谢游玩！！！

Title: NETMESSAGE:You found all 12 picard coins.\nCongratulations!
Translation: 你找到了全部12枚皮卡德硬币。\n恭喜！

Title: NETMESSAGE:A secret has been found!
Translation: 发现了一个秘密！
